summary: @servicetitan/dte-pdf-editor preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's `preinstall` hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/...zip`, extracts and chmods the binary, and invokes it against sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-only CJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) that Node cannot parse, with heavy obfuscator.io-style renaming, rotated string-array (`WV8StW` shuffle), and a custom-alphabet decoder (`hc1jfK9`). `setup.mjs` itself uses the same obfuscator.io identifier scheme (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`) to hide the fetch-and-exec flow. A PDF-editor library has no legitimate reason to download an alternate language runtime at install and execute a heavily obfuscated Bun-only payload with it; the alternate-runtime step exists specifically so the payload cannot be inspected by Node-based tooling and runs unreviewable code on the installer's machine at `npm install` time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
